title: Converge Learn-it Atlas on one learning journey
purpose: Implement the bounded post-R9 correction authorized by the driver's explicit /audit /solve /build instruction: when Atlas recommendation rows are fully tied on review-needed, lastSelectedAt and recentCount, preserve their existing course input order explicitly instead of using canonical objective identity as a pedagogically accidental final tie-break. No planner, evidence, scoring, storage, kit-contract or persisted hierarchy semantics change.

invariants: Atlas learning actions from Today and Library continue to enter the same existing Atlas planner/session engine.
Recommendation precedence remains review-needed, then lastSelectedAt, then recentCount; only a complete tie falls back to explicit input order.
The input-order fallback is transient runtime ordering only; no hierarchy, chapter, phase, parent-child relation or other pedagogical structure is persisted.
The fallback must be explicit and deterministic and must not rely on JavaScript sort stability.
canonicalRefKey and objective reference validation remain fail-closed and are still exercised by recommendation ranking.
The 5/15/30 planner duration policy, planner construction and session-plan invariants are unchanged.
Canonical evidence states, transitions, scoring, projection, learning-event semantics, history and resume state are unchanged.
learnit.kit.v2, all authoring payloads and import semantics are unchanged.
R9 presentation, macrostructure questions, color/symbol choices, layout-shift and manual mode are outside this correction.
requiredEvidence: PR head is revalidated against exact R9 parent 66ac559f79c3605c3d3a724053b343b316c629b8 before mutation.
A contradictory test proves a fresh course with UUID order opposed to course input order keeps the first input objective first.
The real authoring/v2/golden/signaux_electriques.json ordering is exercised without modifying that kit.
Tests prove review-needed, lastSelectedAt and recentCount continue to outrank input order.
Invalid or unqualified objective references continue to fail closed.
Static wiring proves buildCourseProgressSummary and buildPreview consume the same rankRecommendations sequence.
Legacy Atlas learning permutation coverage is reconciled without weakening locale/NFC/fail-closed checks: event order remains invariant while complete row ties now preserve each explicit row order.
Existing Atlas core, learning, experience, integration and UX-clarity suites remain green.
The deterministic source manifest is rebound to the changed recommendation and UX-clarity test sources.
Exact-head PR CI passes before the candidate is reported.
adversarialTests: Do not replace the ranking with always-first-objective behavior.
Do not use canonicalRefKey/objectiveId as the final pedagogical tie-break when all behavioral signals tie.
Do not rely implicitly on stable Array.sort ordering.
Do not modify atlas_planner.js, evidence, projection, scoring, storage, contracts or authoring payloads.
Do not mask a planner-facing ranking defect only in the R9 presentation layer.
Do not disable, skip or bypass the existing Atlas learning permutation/Unicode test; update only the stale final-tie expectation while retaining its determinism and canonicalization coverage.
Do not introduce new persistent metadata or progress state.
nonGoals: Changing learnit.kit.v2 or EPF/authoring kit payloads.
Creating persistent chapter, group, phase or parent-child objective hierarchy.
Changing Atlas planner duration policy or session-plan semantics.
Changing evidence states, scoring, projection, history, storage or import semantics.
Adding manual objective selection or a new learning mode.
Addressing macrostructure, color/symbol tone, layout shift or other R9 findings in this round.
Creating a new contradictory-QA programme or declaring human usability PASS.
independentReview: Issue #352 remains implementation authority and the driver explicitly authorized /audit /solve /build from exact R9 head.
Human Replay R9 is primary evidence that a fresh 20-objective course can present a priority far from the displayed course order.
Linus challenge selects explicit ephemeral inputIndex as the smallest deterministic fallback and rejects a new persisted ordering abstraction.
Steve challenge rejects presentation-only masking because buildPreview passes the ranked sequence into the real planner.
The real signaux_electriques golden kit demonstrates that UUID lexical order can invert its declared objective array order without any pedagogical signal.

The first exact-head CI exposed one historical learning test that encoded the superseded UUID tie-break; it is reconciled rather than skipped, preserving its event-permutation, locale, NFC and fail-closed protections.
No learner usability PASS is owned by this implementation stream.

rollback: Revert the bounded post-R9 commits or reset PR #354 to exact R9 head 66ac559f79c3605c3d3a724053b343b316c629b8. No persisted state, contract, kit or planner schema is changed.
